questions.q: When did the Zeleni venac market open?
questions.e: In the video: "1. oktobra 1926. godine, u Beogradu je otvorena pijaca Zeleni venac" — on October 1, 1926, the Zeleni venac market opened in Belgrade.

o: The opening of a new market
questions.e: In the video: "Na današnji dan pre sto godina otvorena je pijaca Zeleni venac" — on this day a hundred years ago the Zeleni venac market opened.

questions.q: What is Zeleni venac famous for besides trade?
questions.e: In the video: "jedan je od simbola starog Beograda i svedok velikih promena" — one of the symbols of old Belgrade and a witness to great changes.
In the video: "Danas, Zeleni venac je saobraćajno čvorište" — today Zeleni venac is a transport hub.
